name: Ore O Sutenaidekure!!
source:
A biased love novel ADV where you are kept and captured by a common demon, Demo-kun

When you wake up, you find yourself possessing a human from another world...  
By a strange turn of events, you end up being kept by a timid and somewhat cheeky (?) male demon...!?

Live being kept by him, and develop romance and friendship!!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12937]Novelgame page[/url]]
translation:
被随处可见的普通恶魔“戴莫君”圈养并攻略的偏执恋爱小说ADV！

一觉醒来，你发现自己附身到了异世界的人类身上……
阴差阳错之下，你竟然被一只胆小又有点嚣张（？）的公恶魔圈养了起来……！？

一边过着被他圈养的生活，一边培养恋情与羁绊吧！！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12937]Novelgame页面[/url]]
